finalText:
Build now finishes clean with exit code 0. There were two real bugs hiding under the deprecation-warning noise, both from the bundler bump changing the shape of data handed to your code:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the bumped bundler now passes options as `{ retryCount }` instead of `{ retries }`, but this call site still read `options.retries` (undefined), so `.toFixed()` threw. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only accepted explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Simplified it to `flags.backoffEnabled === true`, so unset/undefined now correctly resolves to disabled instead of erroring.

The rest of the ~950-line output (DEP0142/DEP0198/DEP0233/DEP0250/DEP0267 warnings, unused-export, circular-import, deprecated-crypto notices) is genuine upstream/Node deprecation noise — not something a code change here fixes — and the build now reports it as 8 warnings, 0 errors.
